```plato

// The result of a nearest-neighbor search: parallel arrays of item indices
// (into the caller's item list) and their distances from the query point,
// sorted ascending by distance. Empty arrays mean nothing was in range.
type NearestNeighbors
    implements IValue
{
    Indices: Array<ItemIndex>;
    Distances: Array<Number>;
}
```
